entities.summary: Marian Sarah Ogilvie Farquharson, FLS, FRMS was a British naturalist and women's rights activist. The first female Fellow of the Royal Microscopical Society, Farquharson is best remembered for her campaign of women rights to full fellowship of learned societies.
